instruction: Select all images containing a bicycle.

game.semantic_variant: Select all vehicles powered by pedals.
game.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
game.explanation: Ordinary bicycles count, and so does the bicycle with hexagonal wheels: impossible to ride, but still a bicycle. The exercise bike, the horse with pedals and the pedal-powered office chair are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The rocking horse, the kick scooter and the motorcycle are not bicycles.

correct: Your understanding of bicycles has been noted.
All bicycles accounted for. A copy has been placed on file.
Correct. The square-wheeled bicycle has been recognised. Its roadworthiness has not.
partial: Partially correct. Your relationship with bicycles will be reviewed.
Some bicycles escaped your attention. They have been informed.
incorrect: Incorrect. The bicycles have asked not to be contacted further.
Incorrect. The Department is not angry about the bicycles, merely disappointed.

selection_review.reason: Nine distinct, standardised images reviewed together at tile size: two ordinary bicycles (orange and teal mountain bike on grass, three-quarter view; red vintage bicycle against a blue wall, side view), one impossible bicycle (hexagonal wheels, edited photograph), three borderline cases (recumbent exercise bike, generated chestnut horse with bicycle parts, generated pedal-powered office chair) and three non-members (rocking horse, kick scooter, motorcycle). Views, facing directions and settings vary within each role; no view, colour or setting singles out the targets. Grey is the most frequent colour (exercise bike, office chair, rocking horse: 3 of 9).
